title: Foreign Investment Review Board appointments
summary: The Albanese Government has reappointed Mr Bruce Miller AO as part‑time Chair of the Foreign Investment Review Board (FIRB) and appointed Ms Carolyn Kay as part‑time Deputy Chair, as part of her reappointment to the FIRB. title: New crisis housing for young mothers in Brisbane
summary: The Albanese Labor Government is delivering 18 new crisis homes in Brisbane for those who need it most, backed by $13.8 million in funding. These homes will support more than 800 young mothers over the life of the project and give some of our most vulnerable families a safe place to rebuild their lives.
